lines.text: Believers died, their life is hidden with Moses in God, and when Christ appears they will appear with Him in glory.

problems.problem: Its true detail "They will appear with Him in glory" isn't in Colossians 3:4 word for word.
Its wrong detail "They will be sent out to the nations" is 8 words. Swap one short detail (4 words or fewer, like a name, place or number) and list only the swapped words.
